description: List this R3 account's entity templates: reusable bundles (a ship, a lamp post) saved from an Entity in a project, each with its current version and member count. community: true lists everyone's public templates instead. r3_entity_read shows one template's members and versions; r3_entity_import puts a copy into a project; r3_entity_save_template saves an Entity of a project as a template.
